column3: Our company needs to increase its revenue this year. (我們公司今年需要增加營收。)
We have a quarterly meeting to discuss our goals. (我們每季開一次會討論目標。)
The service at the restaurant exceeded my expectations. (那家餐廳的服務超出了我的預期。)
The security system protects the house from any attack. (這個保全系統能保護房子免受任何攻擊。)
The police asked the witness to describe the accident. (警察請目擊者描述那場意外。)
The store had record sales during the holiday season. (這家店在假期期間創下了銷售紀錄。)
I suspect he forgot about our meeting today. (我懷疑他忘了我們今天的會議。)
The police took the man into custody yesterday. (警方昨天將該男子拘留。)
We need to have a serious talk about the project. (我們需要針對這個專案進行嚴肅的談話。)
The rumors about the store closing are baseless. (關於這家店要倒閉的傳聞是毫無根據的。)
